summary: Confine candidate web preparation and builds in a pinned, fail-closed Linux bubblewrap sandbox.

schema.detail: No database or wire schema changes.

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules and digests are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Developer-only deployment tooling. Explicit sandbox mode, bootstrap scratch and pnpm cache inputs are required; candidate-local members and a child-only bwrap-v1 cache namespace prevent reuse of pre-sandbox layouts while retaining the parent's public/private generation-key algorithm.

downtime.detail: Publishing these scripts does not restart or activate a service.

manual.detail: No released-product manual step. Deployment owners explicitly configure and activate the documented sandbox inputs.

recovery.detail: Production state formats and current-plus-one rollback retention remain unchanged.
